items.title: Jerry Gordon interviewed by Monk Rowe and Christian Goodwillie, via Zoom, June 30, 2021
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] My name is Monk Rowe... I’m very pleased to have Jerry Gordon with us today. [INTERVIEWEE] Well thank you, Monk, you made me presentable, I really appreciate that.

ctx.x: Jerry was interviewed via Zoom on June 30, 2021 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive, and Christian Goodwillie, Director of Special Collections.

My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive. I’m going to be joined by Christian Goodwillie who is the Director of Special Collections at Hamilton College. I’m very pleased to have Jerry Gordon with us today. And I’m going to introduce you as a man who channeled his early obsession for music into a number of very productive projects and is valuable for musicians and listeners. How is that for a mouthful?
Well thank you, Monk, you made me presentable, I really appreciate that.
